title: Nextdoor Post Weekly Comment Count Trend
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nextdoor:post comment_count=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(comment_count) as avg_duration, max(comment_count) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst comment count for Nextdoor post events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture comment_count on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average comment count with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether Nextdoor post tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
